name: marking-menu
title: Marking Menu
description: A gesture surface that opens a circular menu of eight destinations around the pointer. Hold still to see the ring, flick a direction to pick blind, or use the Menu button and the arrow keys.
use: Power users repeat the same eight destinations and want one gesture instead of a list to scan.
avoid: Discoverability is low: nothing hints at the hold-and-flick gesture, and the Menu button is the obvious path.
a11y: The press-and-flick surface is a gesture-only path with no role, so keyboard users must find the small Menu button first. (keyboard: yes, labels: good, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: A dark rounded panel with a small icon and Home label at the top left and a Menu button at the top right, with centred prose inviting a press. Opened, a pale circular disc appears with eight outlined icons spaced evenly around the rim and a small hub in the middle.
behaves: Pressing and holding for a moment opens the disc at the cursor; moving past a short distance without waiting turns the stroke into a direction-only pick. The slice nearest the pointer highlights and its name appears in the hub; releasing commits the choice and updates the top-left label.
customise: Pass up to eight items as an array of id, label and icon, choose the surface through children, and handle picks with onSelect; timing and disc size are constants in the source.
weight: moderate: Motion springs plus a requestAnimationFrame stroke trail, only while a gesture runs.
